quotes.quote: I may be the only swords-lady among the pillars who can’t cut a demon’s head off. But anyone who creates poison that can kill demons can be quite amazing.
Use your head not just your spirit. Think think think.
Work at it. All I can do is work hard! That’s the story of my life!
The weak have no rights or choices. Their only fate is to be relentlessly crushed by the strong!
There is a demon who escaped my control, just like Tamayo. Find her and put an end to her. You are the only one I can ask.
